reviews.title: New problem adjust fast time to just before midnight
reviews.text: Can’t adjust the time on my fast to the previous night anymore?? When I try it says start time overlaps with most recent fast.

reviews.title: Monetizing ANA
reviews.text: They are literally making money off of you imagine of yourself. The more you hate the way you look the more likely you are to PAY for this app. Don’t do it. There are free, better apps.

reviews.title: Stop nagging me
reviews.text: Would be a 5 star app but these nags to rate the app are obnoxious and won’t go away, so here’s your review guys!!! Also it’s very expensive for what is effectively a simple timer app. Pretty trash. Probably will have Claude vibe code me a clone with no nags or subscriptions and end my payments.

reviews.title: Forced review
reviews.text: Every time I open the app, sometimes multiple, I am forced to select a review option and then close down the pop up. Really gets in the way of the experience.
